speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Umm... Who are you?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I suspect there might be some errors in the pharmacopoeia, or maybe I mixed up two similar herbs.
May I take a look at it?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Uh... sure. I've got it with me. Here.
Loong's Pearl... Hmm...

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: What is it? Did you find anything?
There's a note in the appendix in fine script.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Really? Let me see... "The Loong's Pearl is a fine medicine, but where fine medicine grows, poison also flourishes. Neighboring the Loong's Pearl there usually grows a poisonous herb known as the Yunjiao Gall, which causes unending stomach pain when consumed."

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: It resembles the Loong's Pearl, so be careful not to mix them up.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I see... Sorry, I should have read more carefully.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Wait, there's more. It also mentions an antidote: "Loong's Pearl can counteract the poison. The most potent ones thrive under waterfalls and have a strong fragrance."
What's wrong?
Sounds credible.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: An antidote growing near poisonous herbs... It aligns with the pharmacological theories. Looks like this isn't a mistake.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Could you help me find a Loong's Pearl beneath the waterfall? I'd go myself, but I really can't walk now.
No problem.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Thank you, friend.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: My stomach hurts... I got food poisoning from accidentally eating the wrong herb to be more precise.
Should I take you to a clinic?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: No need, I'm a doctor myself. I've checked my pulse and it's nothing too serious.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I just didn't expect this herb to be poisonous. It was supposed to be safe. I should've been more careful.
What herb did you take exactly?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: According to the Supplement to Great Pharmacopoeia, it's a herb called the Loong's Pearl.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: The pharmacopoeia says that it isn't poisonous—on the contrary, it can dissolve toxins from plants, wood, metal, and stones.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: You... you're back... Did you find the herb?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Ah, that's a long story. Allow me to formally introduce myself. I'm Shinong, a doctor from Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I've been studying ancient pharmacopoeias and medical books from all over Huanglong.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: While the medical practices of Huanglong share the same roots, many ancient texts have been lost over time.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Luckily, Hongzhen has managed to preserve some texts that may have been lost elsewhere.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: But over the years, as supplements are made, all pharmacopoeias and medical books inevitably suffer from confusions and omissions.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: They even include some superstitions that are completely unrelated to medicine.
Superstitions...?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: For example, there's a remedy that involves holding a rooster at exactly noon, jumping three times under the eaves, and then spinning around three times. It's said that if the rooster crows at that moment, it will drive away any plague.
That's actually... kinda creative?
Here.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: While it might be a fun folklore activity, in practice it doesn't do anything to treat any illnesses.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: That's why I wanted to revise these pharmacopoeias—to remove the unnecessary parts and correct the errors.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: And the best way to do this is to try each herb personally and observe any reactions.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: This way, I can determine their effects and uncover any side effects not mentioned in the texts.
That sounds... quite risky.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Don't worry. After generations of supplements and revisions, I'm certain any herb that poses significant health risks are all highlighted in these pages.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Worst-case scenario, it would just be minor mishaps, like what happened earlier. Such risks are predictable and entirely manageable.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Oh, as a token of gratitude, here's some tonic that I brewed.
...It's not poisonous, is it?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Don't worry. I brewed it using my proven recipe.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Hmm... the slight blue hue, the faint glow, and the aromatic scent. Yes, it matches the description in the pharmacopoeia.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Until we meet again, friend. I wish you good health.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: According to the records, it can be consumed directly if in an emergency, although it might be more effective after processed.
Then just eat it.
You might not have time to wait that long.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Shinong puts the Loong's Pearl in his mouth and begins chewing. His pain visibly eases.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Phew... Much better. It looks like the pharmacopoeia's description of the Loong's Pearl was accurate. Thank you.
Why did you eat the herb in the first place anyway?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Hey, {PlayerName}! Fancy seeing you here!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I've always been gathering Pavo Plums from around this area. But according to Hongzhen Chronicles, only those "found near the hot spring and that can slightly heat up" has medical effects.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: But I've searched everywhere near the hot spring and haven't found any Pavo Plums like the ones described.
I could give you a hand with it.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: R-really? That would be great!
You didn't eat any odd herbs today, did you?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Of course not—well, not yet.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I read an anecdote in Hongzhen Chronicles about a young man from a few hundred years ago who discovered that Pavo Plums has temporary memory-enhance effects.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: He memorized all the texts of Hongzhen with the help of Pavo Plum's incredible effects, earning him the nickname "the Walking Bookshelf."

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: So... you know. I want to try it.
It's probably just a myth.
You sure something like that exists?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I agree that the story might be fictional. But there might be some truth behind it.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: {PlayerName}, did you find any heated Pavo Plums?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As soon as Shinong finishes the Pavo Plum, his face twists into a peculiar expression.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: It's... it's... it's...
What is it? Is it poisonous?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: It's so SPICY! I've tasted countless herbs, but I've never tasted anything this SPICY before!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Wait, I think it's working... Say something, Rover. Anything!
How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if—
Oh, my lord, I beg your forgiveness—

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You effortlessly recite a passage from a tongue twister.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You passionately perform a monologue from a movie film.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Hm... Hm...

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Exactly as the chronicles described... I didn't expect it to exist. Interesting... But it could be a mutation.
Did you catch all of that?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...None, actually.
Whole thing sounded like a bust from the get-go.
That doesn't mean all myths are false.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: After all, it's just a fictional anecdote that can't be taken too seriously. But you never know unless you give it a try.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Perhaps. If I've learned anything from revising these pharmacopoeias, it's never to underestimate the wisdom of those who came before us.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Anyway, these Pavo Plums don't show any special effects, even though they can absorbe heat... and are extremely spicy. Well, that's a small discovery, at least.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}. There are still quite a few herbs from the pharmacopoeia that I haven't tried yet. I'll go and search for them now.
Didn't expect it to exist?
A mutation?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: H-haha. Don't be upset. Presumption is the first step toward truth.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I suspect that the surrounding heat might have induced some changes in these Pavo Plums... potentially altering their medicinal effects.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Now, {PlayerName}, could you please say something after I eat the Pavo Plum?
Sure, what would you like me to say?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Anything will do, preferably something long and complicated. I want to test if it truly helps improve memory.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Um... It's you, {PlayerName}.
What happened...

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I fell off the hill by accident. Luckily I got away with only a swollen leg.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: According to the pharmacopoeia, a herb called Elderflower grows on the hilltop, which is far more effective for treating external injuries than other herbs.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: However, it appears I overestimated my athletic abilities.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Anyway... Ahem, I'll need your help again, {PlayerName}. Could you go to the hilltop and pick some Elderflowers for me?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Elderflowers grow at the top of that hill, so please be careful. But given your abilities, I'm sure it will be a piece of cake.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Yes, those are the Elderflowers!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...They think it's meaningless, just a form of performative art and self-satisfaction. What do you think, {PlayerName}?
It's about carrying on the tradition.
Plus, many people still rely on it.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Exactly. These pharmacopoeias are the legacy of our ancestors' wisdom. Yet, nowadays, few are willing to put in the time to revise them.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: As a result, the errors in these pharmacopoeias keep piling up, making them less and less trustworthy. Many people who could have been cured end up having their conditions worsen or prolonged due to incorrect treatments.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I'm not doing this for fame. I just want to preserve our ancestors' tradition and help more people avoid suffering.
That's truly honorable!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...No, it's just a simple wish. The wish of a doctor.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Maybe I'm just a humble doctor, but at least I have the courage to see it through.
I wish you all the best!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: According to the pharmacopoeia, simply grind them into paste and apply it to the injury. It takes effect almost immediately.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}. Don't worry, I'll get back in town soon.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Shinong applies the paste to his leg, wincing at the sharp sting it causes.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Ah... All right, this should do it now.
Feeling any better?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Much better... I should be back on my feet after a bit of rest.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: You must find it strange, {PlayerName}. Why am I out here risking my life instead of treating others back at the clinic in Jinzhou?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Many believe that I'm doing this for fame and attention.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: For minor ailments that could easily be treated with injections or pills, using herbs involves a lot of effort, including collecting, concocting, and refining the herbs.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Hello there, can you hear me? Hello?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I found a prescription in a medicinal book... The note says it has little effect on this kind of migraine, but I think there is a flaw to it.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: The prescription uses Silver Lotuses as the main ingredient, but it's not effective for the symptoms.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I recall from the Complete Interpretation of Lost Prescriptions that regular Silver Lotuses and those that are over ten years old have opposite effects.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: After observing the migraine's symptoms and checking his pulse, I believe Silver Lotuses which have bloomed for over ten years should be the correct remedy.
In conclusion, the medicinal text likely mixed them up.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: It's possible. There's a chance that a minor omission occurred during the transcription. Unfortunately, this small mistake was enough to render the disease untreatable.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I've administered some relieving medicine to the patient. {PlayerName}, could you go to the nearby hill and collect some Silver Lotuses that are over ten years old? I'll wait here for you.
You can count on me.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Thanks, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: Um… I feel terrible...

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...Yes, I believe it's a type of migraine.
Migraine?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: You're just in time, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Based on my observation, he has a rare disease that is only documented in a pharmacopoeia.
Can you treat him?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...It's tough. The disease can't be completely cured, and can only be alleviated with medication. However...
What is it?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: This is it! It fits perfectly with the description in the pharmacopoeia. Well done, Rover!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...I'm just a regular doctor.

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: Where is your clinic? I'll make a banner for you and send it over as soon as I get home!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: No, no, there's no need for that. {PlayerName} is the one who gathered the herb. I just...
Wrote a prescription?
Brewed the medicine?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: ...I just did what any doctor would do.

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: Nevertheless, please accept my deepest gratitude and respect for both of you.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I've made a lot of progress recently and have finished revising the  pharmacopoeias in Hongzhen.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I'll send them to the clinics. Hopefully, what I'm doing can benefit more people.
Where's your next stop?

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I'll start concocting the medicine now... Please wait.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: Next? There's a long journey ahead. The world is vast, and there are countless pharmacopoeias to rectify. I'm not sure how many I can complete.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: But I will do my best.
Then, good luck.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: May our paths cross again, {PlayerName}.
After a while, the patient takes the medicine and quickly regains consciousness.

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: ...Um. Wh-what happened? Did I... Oh right, I passed out again.

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: It's because of your migraine.

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: Did you help me? It's an old ailment. I've been managing it with medication, but I often...

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: ...Huh? But I feel so much better than before. How is that possible?!

speaker: NPC #900009
anh_en: I'll write you a prescription. Take the medicine as directed for a week and you should fully recover. If you still feel unwell, feel free to contact me anytime.

speaker: NPC #900007
anh_en: Fully recover? But my doctor said my condition is incurable. Are you... some kind of miracle workers?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Sorry, I messed up again. I didn't help at all and just had you protect me once more…
Are you alright?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Yeah, just a few bruises. A good rest will heal them.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I need to practice more. I couldn't even catch your moves!
That happens a lot for beginners.
It's because I'm strong.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Just give me a little more time, and I'll prove myself to you!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Wow! That was so smooth! A solid rock like this crumbled like a crispy cookie under your strike!
Go practice.
Now you're making me hungry.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Understood! I'll work hard and become a master of rock breaking!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Haha, after seeing your moves, I'll work hard and become a master of rock breaking!
...I recall you wanted to be a knight, right?
Under your guidance, Faro has fully trained his strength…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Absolutely! Enlighten me!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Your backhand is weak! So is your forehand! Your legs too! And your reactions! You've got a lot to learn.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: O-okay! I'll practice harder! I promise!
Good. Let's get started then.
Under your guidance, Faro has fully trained his strength…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: So… I… I actually did it? I defeated it?!
Congratulations.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: This is my first time defeating a Tacet Discord! My very first step forward!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: But the Sword in the Rock you gave me is broken now…
It fulfilled its purpose.
And now it's time for you to get a new one.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I'll keep it as a memento. By the way, do you have any feedback on my performance in that battle?
You want me to be honest?
The people who were attacked by the Tacet Discords express their gratitude for your help and leave the scene.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Just like the knights in the legends. Even when they knew the battlefield held more than just victory and glory, they marched on without regret.
You're getting more and more like a knight.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Ahem, it's all thanks to your guidance. Without you, my dream of becoming a knight could've ended long ago.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Phew! Thank you for your help. Otherwise, I might've gotten myself into trouble again.
You bought me some time.
You still need more practice.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I was just overstretching myself… I know I'm not yet capable of protecting others.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Yeah, I know I'm not yet capable of protecting others.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Just facing Tacet Discords at this level was already overwhelming for me.
But you still did your best to protect them, didn't you?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I swore during the "Sword Bestowment Ceremony" to lend a hand to those in need.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Oh, dear Imperator, I'll always remember that knight's bravery…
You met a knight?

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Indeed. On that fateful day, I ran into a fierce Tacet Discord outside the town. A brave young man rushed to help me, fighting the monster with something like a pitchfork.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Once we were safe, I asked for his name, and he told me that he was the squire of that "Roving Knight who wanders between the realms of day and night."

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: It appears that knights still exist in this era…
Well, I think I've met him before too.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Is that so? He left in such a hurry, and all I could do was watch him go.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: This brief encounter brought comfort to my broken heart. Perhaps our paths will cross again someday?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I'm ready, so what do we have for today's training?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I will! But there's still so much to learn, so I hope you'll keep training me!
Absolutely.
Under your guidance, Faro begins a new level of real combat training.
It's you! Squire of the Roving Knight!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Oh… Haha, how did you know that?
Why did you leave my title when you were the one doing good deeds?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I'm sorry for doing that without asking. It's just that your guidance has brought me closer to my dream.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Just as the tales of knights inspired me, I hoped that by spreading the name of the Roving Knight, others might also find motivation.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: People would see that knights who uphold justice and righteousness are still active, in Whisperwind Haven and even in other places in Rinascita, not lost to time.
You'll earn your own title one day.
Leave your own title next time.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Oh, dear Imperator, I'll always remember that knight's bravery…
You met a knight?

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Indeed. On that fateful day, I ran into a fierce Tacet Discord outside the town. A brave young man rushed to help me, fighting the monster with something like a pitchfork.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Once we were safe, I asked for his name, and he told me that he was just a nameless knight who happened to pass by.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: It appears that knights still exist in this era…
Well, I think I've met him before too.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: Is that so? He left in such a hurry, and all I could do was watch him go.

speaker: NPC #900107
anh_en: This brief encounter brought comfort to my broken heart. Perhaps our paths will cross again someday?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I'm ready, so what do we have for today's training?
Under your guidance, Faro begins a new level of real combat training.
It's you! Nameless Knight!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Oh… Haha, how did you know that was me?
You're probably the only knight who fights with a pitchfork.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I was on my way to help with some farm work when I heard someone calling for help. So I grabbed my tool and rushed to assist.
Why didn't you leave your name?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Well… I thought names weren't as important. What truly matters is that the deeds of knights are passed down by people.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Besides, I'm far from being worthy of a knight's title… So I really hope you'll continue to guide me in my training.
Absolutely.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Phew, I'm really glad you were here. Dealing with those Tacet Discords alone is still a bit much for me.
Don't push yourself too hard.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Don't worry! I'll immediately run away if things get too tough. I just wanted to buy some time for those passersby.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Seems like I'm not that afraid of those monsters anymore, but I still need the strength to protect others.
On that note, it's time for your training.
Then let's kick off today's session.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Wait! You mean now?
Under your guidance, Faro begins an intensive and comprehensive training session.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Phew… You're here. I managed to defeat those Tacet Discords, and the people were only a little shaken.
I thought you needed my help.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Oh no, I may have used too much force and broken my weapon again. It took me quite a while to find one as suitable as that.
Out with the old, in with the new!
Weapons are expendable.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: You're right. What matters most is the chivalrous spirit of protecting others, right?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I will keep moving forward, following in your footsteps.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Come on! Show your fangs and claws, you monsters! A knight of justice and righteousness will never back down!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Wait... No way, they're too fast...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Looks like someone's in trouble nearby... I'd better go check it out.)

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Knight stories, traditional cuisines, and Night Reveries… My hometown is rich with these relics of the past.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: No wonder so many kids there dream of becoming knights.
You seem to be the one who has ventured the farthest.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: That's because I have the best mentor.
Stop, you're making me embarrassed.
Just don't mention my name when you mess up!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Hahaha, knights never lie.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I promise, I won't let you down.
You and Faro escort the people who were attacked by the Tacet Discords to a safe place…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Hm? What's that?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I've learned so much from you again. I never expected someone to take down Tacet Discords so quickly.
You're getting better.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I've just accumulated… a bit of experience in taking hits. If a tougher Tacet Discord had shown up earlier, I might not have been able to handle it.
A Spearback!
A Gulpuff!
The Crownless!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Where?! Oh, that's no fun.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Where? But a Gulpuff doesn't seem… that dangerous, right?

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Phew! Thank you so much! Without your help, I'd have been in real trouble!
You flatter me. But I like it.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: It's truly an honor to meet you! Actually, I've been searching for someone skilled in combat.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I know this is a sudden request, but could you be my mentor and train me for a while? I want to be stronger, a knight who can protect others.
Why do you want to be a knight like that?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Well, it's a long story. When I was little, I got lost in the wild and ran into some scary Tacet Discords at night. Just when I thought I was done for, someone showed up with a sword and saved me.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I can't remember his face or voice, but I still vividly recall his figure—a knight shielding the weak from danger.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: That moment inspired me. I want to be a "shield," not a coward who trembles at the sight of Tacet Discords.
But confronting Tacet Discords is dangerous for ordinary people.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I know. It may be hard to tell, but I'm also a Resonator.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Though very subtle, you do sense a hint of Resonance power in him.)

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I'm Faro from Egla Town, by the way. I'm training to become a knight. How should I address you, hero?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Please, will you be my mentor and guide me?
Alright, I'll help you.
I'd love to, but I'm quite busy right now. Maybe sometime later?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Thank you. Ouch, seems like I twisted my arm while fighting those monsters…
We can start your training once you've recovered.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: No problem! A good sleep will fix me right up.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: That's fine! I'll focus on my practice while you handle your business!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (For some reason, you feel that your response will leave a lasting influence on this young man.)
I'm the Roving Knight, a wanderer between the realms of day and night.
Just call me {PlayerName}. I merely passed by and did what I could.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: The Roving Knight…?!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: No wonder you fought with such skills! So you really are a knight. I thought knights... no longer existed.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Oh, you're as mighty as the noble knights in the stories. No, you've surpassed them all!
Well, I know a thing or two about fighting.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Thank you for saving me again. I was so close to being overwhelmed by those monsters.
You're quite stubborn, but that can be a good thing.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Do you remember the favor I asked before? Will you train me this time?
Fine.
I have to excuse myself for now.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: That's great! You finally agreed! Thank you! Ouch, seems like I twisted my ankle in the last fight.
We can start your training once you've recovered.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: No problem! A good sleep will fix me right up.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I see. Goodbye then. I'll keep practicing on my own until you're willing to teach me.
You really need to stop putting yourself in danger like this.
Recklessness won't help you.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: But if I stay in safe places, my dream will slip away from me.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: A-and my efforts aren't in vain! I can feel myself getting more familiar with their fighting styles.
But you may keep getting hurt.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I know. Just the thought of a future like that sends shivers down my spine and makes my legs tremble when I face those monsters.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: But think of the knight who ventured deep into Whisperwind Haven and faced the Giant alone. He must have encountered something far worse.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Even in the darkest moments, he endured until the end. I wish to follow his example.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: HELP!!! IS ANYONE OUT THERE? CAN ANYBODY HEAR ME? PLEASE, HELP!!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That voice sounds familiar… Could it be…?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Phew! I'm finally out! I thought I'd be stuck in that dark cave forever!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Maybe you are the one that can really pull it out…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Legend says this Sword in the Rock chooses its owner, and only those with true courage and integrity can wield it.
Really?
That sounds like me.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: The stage is yours now. Oh, I can almost hear it whispering to me—"You don't have the right, O you don't have the right."
The sword looks like part of the rock now…
How did you get trapped in there?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Well, I wanted to find a proper weapon before the official training started.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I heard that the Mad Knight's sword was hidden around here, so I came to look for it.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: And there it was! Just like the legends said, stuck in a rock!
You mean that giant rock over there?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: That's right! But no matter how hard I pulled, it wouldn't budge.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: I must've spent ages trying! Then suddenly, I heard rumbling and loud crashes from outside. Before I knew it, I was trapped by falling rocks.
Let me give it a try.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Congratulations on retrieving the long-lost Sword in the Rock! I never expected you could just break the rock to get it…
Faro, the Novice Knight.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: …Yes? Are you calling me?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Can you swear to this sword that from now on, you will only fight for justice and righteousness, and help those in need?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Absolutely! I, Faro, swear to this sword that I will only fight for justice and righteousness from now on.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Good, then this Sword in the Rock belongs to you now.
You pick up the weathered "sword" and hand it to the young man before you with sincerity. He stands there, surprised, and after a moment, he accepts it with trembling hands.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: But it's just a piece of pipe…
Even if the legend isn't real, your vow is.
What makes a knight isn't their weapon but their spirit.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: You're right. When I was a child, I used to play knight with a stick.
Is this really a sword?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Whether it's a weathered pipe or a magnificent sword, a knight's responsibilities remain the same.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Thank you. This looks sturdy and should last quite a while.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Well, after all those years, I guess it's a bit weathered…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: But look at its blade! It's so slender, and it definitely has a unique texture compared to an ordinary sword.
It's not a pipe, is it?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: How could that be? It is… Well, fine, it's just a piece of pipe.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Maybe some prankster decided to follow the legend and stuck it in that rock?

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: *Sigh* I'm becoming more gullible. I once searched for the Sword in the Rock with Carlow for ages, but we found nothing…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: All these mysteries of knighthood... who knows which is real and which is not? I just didn't want to dig deeper and end up disappointed…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: So, today's training's about breaking rocks? I remember I once heard from a Pioneer Association member that…

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Understood! I'll watch and learn carefully!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Breaking rocks with your chest is quite popular somewhere outside of Rinascita.
I think you might have misunderstood.
Well then, today's training is "breaking rocks with your chest."

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Haha, you're right. It's impossible for an ordinary person to do that!

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: What? Really? But that sounds impossible!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Alright, chit-chat's over. Today, we simply focus on fundamental strength training. We'll be shattering the rocks with our weapons.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Just like how you got the Sword in the Rock? I'm ready. We can start any time!
No rush. I'll show you how it's done first.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: What? A Tacet Discord in the stone?!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Looks like today's strength training just turned into a real combat session.

speaker: NPC #900106
anh_en: Oops… No...

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Hey, {PlayerName} is here.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Haha, you got it! That's the one—Milo's proposal.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: He said he's got firsthand experience. Ever since our coffee machine broke, he's gone into thesis stagnation.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: The review board read the report... and approved our budget. Now the library has a new double-deck espresso machine. How's that for practical social value...?

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Sigh... Thanks for the vote of confidence. That was my proposal, but it got rejected.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: The official reason was "Blubbin Puffins are not an approved research partner." Well, I can't argue with that.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: I'll give you another shot, the correct answer is closer than you think.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Here's to science and anxiety. Thank you for coming today, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Our AnomSci Group finally managed to secure a small amount of research funding, but only on the condition that we prove the project "has practical social value."

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Aniko, Milo, and I each submitted a proposal. Want to guess which one was approved in the end?

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: A: The effect of motorbike speed on student punctuality. B: The correlation between campus coffee-machine sales and final exam pass rates. C: The difference in Blubbin Puffin movement speeds on sunny versus cloudy days.
A. Sounds like the kind of research that has real-world significance.
B. Coffee and survival, that's a combo with real social value.
C. That sounds very AnomSci.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Sadly, that's not the right answer. That was Aniko's idea. He tried to test it himself, couldn't stop the motorbike in time, and went straight into a wall... which is why he's not here today.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: I'll give you another shot, the correct answer is closer than you think.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Oh, {PlayerName}! What a coincidence, here to check out my new experiment?

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: That's right! That one that gave a strong reaction!

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: We observed it swaying in along with the music—its leaves opened and closed three times their normal rate. It seemed to be thoroughly enjoying it.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: You could say that's its own kind of "rocking out."

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: ...Plant's reaction to that is weird.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Every time the end-of-class bell sounded, it slowly leaned toward the window. I suspect it's trying to escape reality.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: A physiological, world-weary response. Worth further study.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: See? Pretty interesting, right, {PlayerName}? I like to think the potted plants are enjoying their own little campus lives, too.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Drop by the AnomSci Group whenever you have time, maybe it'll give you some new inspiration.
Sounds like a good idea.
If I get the chance, I will.
What experiment?

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Sure. You're always welcome.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: I've been trying to build a "plant signal transmission model” to see how potted plants react to different acoustics.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: I just played different sounds to three plant samples. Guess which pot reacted the most?
The one listening to classical music.
The one listening to heavy rock.
The one listening to the campus radio.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Hmm... That's what we thought, too. But it didn't give any reaction at all. It's completely quiet, might even be asleep.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Conclusion: The potted plant may lack interest in fine art.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Get over here, quick! We just got a motion update from Miracle One!

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: This chubby bird that normally just hops around is now running faster than any rabbit!

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Meet us at the library. Be there or be square!

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: The kind of speed we're looking at, it's not hopping, it's full-on sprinting! It's definitely gone through some kind of super evolution!
What's Miracle One?
Who's Aniko...?
Who are you?
Did I just get roped in on your big plan...?

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Aniko says it's almost certainly a mutated specimen. We're going after it. Meet us at the library!

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Who are you?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: What's Miracle One?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Who's Aniko...?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Yeah, you did.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Did I just get roped in on your big plan...?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: A miracle?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: That sounds like a scam.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Aniko's already gone ahead with a net. We're going to corner it!

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Huh? Did I send this to the wrong person?
Yeah, you did.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Then you're in luck, my friend. Want to come and witness a miracle in the making?
A miracle?
That sounds like a scam.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: That's right. We've found a miraculously evolved Kronapuff.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: It's no scam. We've discovered a miraculously evolved Kronapuff.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You close the message and pause for three seconds to mull it over.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: —Go to class, or go catch a hyper-evolved bird.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The choice is obvious.
I'm here. Where's Miracle One?

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Question: What caused this astonishing speed boost?
A: It hyper-evolved and gained double jump skill!
B: Equipment malfunction. Phantom coordinates perhaps?
C: It... got gobbled up by something that moves even faster.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Uh, I really wish I could go "Correct!"... but the answer is C.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Correct. What we're tracking now is, in fact, Miracle One's... successor.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: From an evolutionary perspective, energy has indeed been transferred.
...Okay.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Miracle One has continued its scientific significance in a new form! Your presence as a witness is also deeply meaningful, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Thanks for coming!

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: That's a... ahem... very good question.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: By the time you arrive, a diffusion of failure and awkwardness hangs in the air.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Uh, I really wish I could go "Correct!"... but the answer is C.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: I'd love to say, "Of course, the outcome couldn't possibly be as cruel as this."... But unfortunately, it is.

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: Upon arriving at the coordinates, we found only a few leftover violet feathers. Miracle One's signal is still active, but further analysis shows that its movement speed matches that of a large carnivorous animal.
So what you're really tracking now is...
It's the one that ate it?

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: Well, in a nutshell: our research has, uh, moved onto the "metaphysical" stage.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: To be more precise, Miracle One is currently...

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: ...Being irreversibly reclaimed by nature.
What's that supposed to mean?
What are you trying to say?

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Why don't we make this into a Q&A? Make it more academic.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Here's the question: Our tagged Kronapuff's movement data shows its average speed today skyrocketed from 0.6 m/s to 6 m/s.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Hey, what's up, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Come on over, we'll be waiting at the research outpost! Aniko and Milo already have everything set up.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Oh, right, don't forget to bring your motorbike!
...I have a bad feeling about this.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Any plans for today? Got some free time?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: The way you're asking... I have a bad feeling about this.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: We're heading out to the research outpost today to work on a brand-new research topic. Want to come and take a look?

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: So naturally, the first all-purpose solution that came to mind was you.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: What is it this time?

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: Not really interested.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Well, yes, I indeed come with another invitation.
What is it this time?
Not really interested.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: This time—plants.

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: Oh, don't be like that! Just hear what I have to say first! This time it's about a very... special plant!

speaker: NPC #701153
anh_en: It's more on the unique side… And we could use some extra "firepower."

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I still have no idea what they're up to... Guess I'll find out when I get there.)

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: Perfect. It just happens that we can't afford a proper wind blower.

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: Of course, it does! We can't afford to rent a proper wind blower.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Since we don't have funding, we've decided to harness the powers of humans and motorbikes to create wind all our own for the Academy.
In common phrase, please.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Well... You drive the motorbike, use its exhaust to blast a high-velocity airstream, and we'll conduct our recordings and observations in quick succession!
We could give it a try.
…That doesn't sound very safe. Or very scientific.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: It'll be fine, have faith in us, {PlayerName}. We're about to witness another miracle! Let me just strap these plants onto your bike first...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The three move in swift motion, quickly fastening several potted plants to your motorbike's exhaust.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: All set. Time to hit the road, {PlayerName}! We're ready to collect data when you are!

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Hey, {PlayerName}! You got here quick.
All right... Here goes.
Well, I'm here. Are you going to tell me what's actually going on?

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Welcome aboard, the testing site for the "Plant Spore Release Efficiency Under High-Velocity Airstream Disturbance"!
That's one hell of a title!
...A name that sounds more promising than the results are likely to be.

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: We're studying the dispersion angle, density, and energy distribution of plant spores in high-speed air currents. {PlayerName}, you didn't forget to bring your motorbike with you, did you?
Yeah, I brought it...
What does my motorbike have to do with your experiment?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: By the time you finished your ride and came back around, you see them all coughing and frantically wiping spores off their faces.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: *Cough*, *cough*, *cough*, *cough*, *cough*, *cough*... All right!  All right! That's good enough!

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: D-Did we... get anything?!

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: Not sure... All I could see was green...

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Let's see here... *cough*... Looks like we managed to capture plenty of data!

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Thanks, {PlayerName}! You were a huge help!
As long as it worked out for you.

speaker: NPC #701155
anh_en: Hello. Umm, is this {PlayerName}? My name's Milo.

speaker: NPC #701155
anh_en: You can call it the AnomSci Group for short.

speaker: NPC #701155
anh_en: We're hoping you'll join us, as an honorary member, maybe?

I should think about it first.

speaker: NPC #701155
anh_en: Awesome! When you have a moment, come to the back entrance of the library.

speaker: NPC #701155
anh_en: Sure, take your time. When you have a moment, come to the back entrance of the library.

anh_en: I remember you.

anh_en: Not really... Who are you again?

anh_en: Doesn't really roll off the tongue.

anh_en: Sounds like fun.

anh_en: I'll join... I guess?

anh_en: I should think about it first.

anh_en: An invitation?

anh_en: Ah, that's a relief.

anh_en: Ah... It's fine if you don't remember.

anh_en: I actually got your contact info from Ronan.

speaker: NPC #701155
anh_en: He asked me to deliver a formal invitation on his behalf.
Invitation?

anh_en: Yes. We've recently formed an official small research-interest and mutual-aid group called the "Anomalies and Scientific Fantasies Joint Research Group."

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Hey, if it isn't our future honorary member!

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Hmm... technically speaking, including you, that makes four of us. Yep, all members accounted for.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Oh, don't make that face! We gotta start somewhere...

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: We're planning some fun research topics later on. Things like spore resonance frequencies, Exoswarm parasitic structures, and... dreamland catalyst experiments.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: I also want to run a campus-wide quiz event and use the questions to find people whose minds think a little differently. You know—geniuses like you.
That actually sounds kind of fun.

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Haha, then it's settled! Welcome aboard—"Anomalies and Scientific Fantasies Joint Research Group"!

speaker: NPC #700723
anh_en: Just call it "AnomSci". Stop saying the full name.

speaker: NPC #700724
anh_en: Well, welcome, {PlayerName}.
Hello, everyone.
I haven't actually agreed to this yet...

speaker: NPC #700722
anh_en: Hahaha, {PlayerName}, check this out!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Ronan offers you a metal badge. Its surface is engraved with a strange winged creature that gleams in the sunlight.

speaker: NPC #700722
