anh_en: As for in person sales... I've never done that. And, uh, I get the jitters when I talk to people face-to-face.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Plus... people on the street aren't interested in stones at all. I wouldn't know who to sell them to even if I wanted to...
Relax, what can your stones be used for anyway?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Fixing houses, generally, but hardly anyone does that even in Jinzhou nowadays.
Business isn't doing well?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Or maybe paving roads? But that's not something anybody can just get up and do...
What else?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Well, let me think... Oh, right, making statues!
That means...

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Thanks! I know who would want the stones now!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Oh, would you... mind coming with me? There's no way I'll be able to get a deal on my own.
Sure. I'm not doing anything right now anyway.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Wow, thank you so much! I'll get stuff ready and meet you at the souvenir store in town!
Hardly any customer, it seems.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Isn't it obvious?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: ...Not "hardly any". Make that "none."

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Oh... Are you a customer? Sorry, I thought everybody left.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: So, are you interested in our stones?
Not really, sorry...
I mean, who would buy stones on the street?

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Welcome, sir!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: (He's so much more professional in sales than I am...)

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Ahem. No, actually, we're here... to sell.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Sell? You mean like the herbs you found and gathered on your trip?
Not herbs. Stones.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Yes... yes, and quality stones for sculpting at that! We offer all kinds of them! Here's a sample... for you to... take a look.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: It does look nice, both the texture and color... But this is not from Mt. Firmament, is it?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: No, it isn't. I brought it with me from Jinzhou!

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Wait, is there something wrong with it?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Not in the slightest! Our company has been in the stone business for over 10 years in Jinzhou. And we... we've always offered the best there is at affordable prices...

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Sounds a bit suspicious. If the rocks are fine, why are you so nervous?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Are you... talking to me?
This is his first crack at sales. Please understand.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: I see. That explains a lot. When I first worked here, I couldn't even get a whole sentence out. It's okay, you just need more practice.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: All right, then let's get down to business. What's the price?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Yongxin gives an irresistible quote.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: That really is pretty cheap... I've heard that they have to rely on heavy-duty machinery to mine rocks out there, but this...
Do you find the offer appealing?
It's really a great deal.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Sorry, I can't do it.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Is the price too high for you? That's fine, I'm sure we can work something out...

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: It's not about the price. These statues were carved out of Mt. Firmament rocks.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Yes! Is this your first time in Hongzhen and looking to buy something? Well, you've come to the right place!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Mt. Firmament rocks...? Are they different from the ones in Jinzhou?

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Of course. Every rock in Mt. Firmament had been blessed by our great Sentinel.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Well, I'm not joking with you. Don't believe me? Just take a look at that!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Out the window? Is that... the Loong's Crest? Wait, the shape... Don't tell me...

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: That's right. Not just Loong's Crest, the appearance of the entire Mt. Firmament was hand-chiseled by the ancestors of Hongzhen to resemble our Sentinel!

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: It's okay, you're not the first to be blown away by this marvel. Like I've always said, the story of Mt. Firmament's Sentinel statue really should be included in the tourism pamphlet...

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: All right, I got to get back to work. Hongzhen's been bustling with visitors lately. Catch you later, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: What would you like? We have Mt. Firmament oolong tea, made from tea leaves freshly picked this year using ancient techniques. It's only ten Shell Credits an ounce, with a money-back guarantee!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: I guess I still got a lot to learn about Hongzhen... I'll hang around and see if I can get new clients. If I work hard... I can definitely...
You still have to conquer your anxiety first.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: My mind just... goes blank and I don't know what to say.
Wait, we're not here to buy.
Say what you say best, of course.
Just repeat the words you were typing before.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: That's it...? That does make sense... Let me dwell on it. Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Ah, it's you, {PlayerName}. Do you know this gentleman?
Yeah.
Actually, we just met.

speaker: NPC #900044
anh_en: Well, since it's your friend, I can give him 20% off all items in the store!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: There you are, {PlayerName}.
We're here to make sales.
You got us mixed up with someone else.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Yongxin quickly explains his intent.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Oops, my mistake. He didn't look familiar to me so I thought he was from Tongchuan Pharmacy.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: But I don't have time for that right now. As you can see, I'm swamped here... And the fact that the medicine from Tongchuan Pharmacy still hasn't arrived yet makes it even worse.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Oh, right! Can you check on the delivery for me, {PlayerName}? If I don't have the spa ready soon, I'll get complaints.
No problem.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Yes! I knew I could count on you!
Your face is glowing red.
And that's a lot of sweat.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: It... it's too hot here for sure. That's hot springs for you. Even the air feels hot...

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Hello... I am...

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Here you are, finally. Tongchuan Pharmacy sent you, right? Do you have any idea how busy I am today, and you just got here? Where's my shipment?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Shipment...?

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: The medicine I ordered for spa therapy. Wait, why are you empty-handed?

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: And {PlayerName}... when did you start working for Tongchuan Pharmacy?

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: You're a rare sight, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Here for some herbs? I just got a fine batch in from Jinzhou. They work wonders for both internal and external use.
I'm here for the herbs for Spring's Taste.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Oh my, can't believe that slipped my mind.

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: I was going to send someone over this morning, but the guy called in sick. Xinyang must be getting impatient by now...

speaker: NPC #900042
anh_en: Let me see... Yeah, should be these. Thanks for delivering them, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: You're back, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: ...Well, our rockery comes in a variety of styles, such as the Jinzhou border style, the Mengzhou garden style, and the newest luxury style from Huanglong capital. We also offer customization based on your own design, dear customer!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Dear customer, you can order now for free shipping to Hongzhen, plus a three-year warranty! If you have any questions or need more information, please leave a message and I will...
Ahem. You can stop right there.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: ...Is this how people from Jinzhou sell stuff nowadays? Sounds a bit weird... but it's actually kind of appealing?
The best bang for your buck, dear customer.
Your hot spring deserves the enticing look, dear customer.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Hm... Indeed, I do think the spring is missing something, so if I added this...

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Phew, I guess that's one deal closed. Now I can face the boss.
You seem to be under a lot of stress.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Well, my boss was never optimistic about Hongzhen, or he would've never sent a low-man-on-the-totem-pole like me here.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Yes, this is it. I spent a lot of money on this new recipe. Now, all I have to do is put it in the hot spring.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: But I did it... I've taken the first step, and that's because I have your encouragement and help...
So, what's up with the "dear customer" thing?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Didn't you want me to say what I say best? That's all I know...

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: I still came off a little nervous, but much better than before.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Then I'll have to keep working at it. Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Dip in the hot spring just for fun, twice to dodge the flu and run, thrice for muscles feeling fine, four times to make sickness decline!

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Oh, the fellow over there... What did you want to see me for again?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Excuse me, but... do you need stones for your hot spring?

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: Stones? You mean for renovating the pool? No, because we're in peak season so it will cost me a lot of money to renovate now.

speaker: NPC #900089
anh_en: How about rockery, got any of that?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Yes, yes! We... do...
Tell me about your best product.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: It's simple, really. If we create a macroscopic node with Resonator A, we can use that as the coordinate to perform a three-dimensional expansion through inverse anisotropic frequency...
How much of that did you get?
This'll be a great learning experience.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: (Frankly, it's like a foreign language to me, except he's not a foreigner.)

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Do you know each other, {PlayerName}?
Yeah, but actually...
He's here to make a sale.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Oh, right, I remember now. Pardon me. I've been knee-deep in the new project...

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Phew... Thanks, {PlayerName}. Now we can finally get back to business.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: You must be the hunter we hired to collect Scarefrost Deer samples, right?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Huh?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: So you want us to build a three-meter-tall marble control station from your model?
He's the stone merchant you were looking for.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Ha.. haha... Oh, is that so? Oh right... I think I did mention something like that.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Actually, we've been working on a new project that mainly focuses on the impact of the Sentinel's time barrier on Mt. Firmament's ecology.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: As you can tell, even though the time barrier is gone, the residual effect caused the snow to be permanent, leading to the unique ecology you have now.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: The environment may appear stable now, but who can guarantee it won't collapse or become disastrous for Mt. Firmament in a few years or decades?
What's that got to do with stones?

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: The people of Hongzhen believe that Sentinel's power has seeped into the rocks of Mt. Firmament.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Therefore, comparing the frequencies of the rocks of Mt. Firmament to those from other areas could give us a clue to what's really going on.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Ahem... but there's a... big hurdle.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: We're running out of budget. It's the director's fault. No matter how miraculous Mt. Firmament is, we just can't afford all these projects at once...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: No, no, I said three-dimensional expansion. It means, uh, taking apart the model's original four-dimensional structure...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: So... can you give me a discount? Please, the future of Mt. Firmament is at stake.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: But what I'm offering is already really low... We still have to haul the stones all the way from Jinzhou, and we might even run into Tacet Fields on the way...

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: This is a very crucial study, so please...
It's your decision to make, Yongxin.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: What, me...?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: But I... I can't make the call. I'm a nobody... I'm not even a professional salesman.
Your opinion is very important.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: *sigh* I must be out of my mind... Fine, I'll sell them to you at cost price.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: You need a four-legged stand, too? No problem. It can all be done as long as we have the blueprint.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: Really? That's wonderful! I'll put in a budget request right now!

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: This probably isn't going to work out for me... The boss might fire me on the spot when I get back.
Having second thoughts?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: I don't know. But they seemed so passionate... and committed.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: I looked into the research station before I came. They declined generous offers in Jinzhou and other places to work in these makeshift conditions.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: I don't understand exactly what they're studying, but I know it's important.
You made the right decision.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I feel much better now.

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: I'm still a little bummed-out about it, though... It took me so long to get to this point.
Your hard work will pay off.
Am I interrupting anything?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: Hope so.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: {PlayerName}! I was just telling this gentleman here about our latest project, but he... seems to be proposing a bolder, more profound approach.

speaker: Nghiên Cứu Viên
anh_en: To be honest, some of the suggestions are quite inspirational, like the four-directional magnetic restraint he mentioned, despite the lack of practical proof...
...How did you two manage to communicate?

speaker: NPC #900008
anh_en: (Thank heavens you're here, {PlayerName}...)

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: I can't leave you here alone. It's too dangerous. Please come back with me!
It's a bit of trouble, but it's fine.
Thank you so much. I'm trying to persuade him to go home and get proper treatment, hoping it will help him recover sooner.
Oh no, I'm really sorry! I'm trying to persuade him to go home and get proper treatment, hoping it will help him recover sooner.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hey, young {Male=man;Female=lady}! Shiying must be happy to see someone visit him!

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: Grandpa, now that the flowers are delivered, how about we head back home?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: No, I have to stay with them. I promised them, so I have to keep my word.

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: Stop being stubborn, grandpa! You’re trying to enter a military facility! You're no longer in service and you’re obstructing the military officers!

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I did NOT obstruct anyone! I didn't even try breaking into it! I was just standing here! You kids... Can't you kids just let this old man have his peace?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: All my comrades are here. I'm not going anywhere!

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I won't cause any trouble. I just want to spend a little more time with them.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: We promised we'd always be friends and stick together, but they weren't as fortunate as me. Let me stay here and have a chat with them. Is that too much to ask?

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: Alright, as long as you're happy...

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: But, if you can't find your way home or cause any trouble for the soldiers or Patrollers, no matter what you say, I'll take you home, okay?
You are?
What happened?

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: Nice to meet you. I'm Santong, and this is my grandpa.

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: I asked my grandpa where he went every day, and he mentioned meeting up with his old friends.

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: Only now do I realize he's been coming here daily! I just wanted to convince him to return to Jinzhou, but he wouldn't listen. So frustrating!

speaker: Tam Thông
anh_en: I hope he hasn't caused you any trouble. I apologize on behalf of my grandpa.
It's okay. I don't mind.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Well, if it isn't Rover! Long time no see!

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Can you go there? It might be too much trouble for you.
It's okay.
I've done this for you before.
Alright, thanks for your help. Can you pass a message to Yuandong?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Really? Did I trouble you before? Sorry, I'm getting forgetful...
Thanks for lending a hand. Can you pass a message to Yuandong?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: His granddaughter has joined the Branch of Resonmedical Science at the Academy, so his unfulfilled wish is finally realized.
Sure, I'll pass on the message.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: How do I know your name? That's strange. Sorry, young {Male=man;Female=lady}.
Do you need me to help you deliver those flowers?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: How did you know I was about to send flowers to my friends?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I wanted to head to the cemetery and give this bouquet to Yuandong. It was only when I got there that I realized civilians couldn't get access to the cemetery anymore.
Let me help you.
You put the flowers in front of the tombstone and inform Yuandong about his granddaughter...

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: You're back so soon. It feels like you just left. Was your delivery smooth?
Without a hitch.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Fantastic. When he smells the fragrance of these flowers, he'll know I miss him.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Yuandong, you used to say our home is right beneath our feet. Now, this place has truly become the home for your family.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: You can rest assured, guarding them here…

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Ah, there you are. It's been a long time since our paths crossed.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Oh, so you're really Lee. Sorry, seems like my eyes are getting worse as well.
Since you're still around, can you do me a favor? Can you go to the cemetery and place these flowers for me?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I knew it. I couldn't have mistaken you for someone else.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Why are you here? Are you here to maintain the front-line defenses again? You've been working hard to give us a peaceful life. Thank you.
If you happen to have spare time today, can you do me a favor? Can you go to the cemetery and place these flowers for me?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hm? None of them are correct? Rover… sounds familiar.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Well, what was I going to do?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Right! Can you go to the cemetery and place these flowers for me? I want to give them to my comrades.
Leave it to me.
Do you remember me?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Of course! You're Lee from next to Santong's place, right? How could I forget you? Why are you here? On leave?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hm? Wait a minute, no... Come closer. Let me take a good look.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Almost mistook you, sorry. Now I see clearly. You're Yao from the Ministry of Development.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Am I right? I didn't get your name wrong, did I?
I'm Lee.
I'm Yao.
I'm Rover.
You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: You're back so soon. It feels like you just left. Was your delivery smooth?
Without a hitch.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Great! Thank you! When they smell this flower, they know they are still being missed.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Rover, long time no see. Do you remember me?
Do you remember me?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Ugh, hahaha! Yes, I remember now.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Sorry, I caused you a lot of trouble before.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I wanted to say…
Delivering flowers?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Y-yes, thank you for your help.
It's okay. I'm already familiar with it.
You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: That's fast. Was your delivery smooth?
Without a hitch.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Great, thank you! When they smell this flower, they know they are still being missed.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Wonder why there's still no reply...

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: If it weren't for them stopping me, I'd want to visit them in person and tell them I haven't forgotten about them.
I'll help you deliver these flowers.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: That's great. Thank you so much.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hello there, stranger. Are you a Midnight Ranger? Could you do this old man a favor and check why General hasn't approved my return application?
What's that?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: General promised to let me come back and visit my comrades.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Look, I brought a bunch of flowers for Qiu.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I've told them General has already given me permission, but they still won't let me through! Why won't they listen?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Young {Male=man;Female=lady}, could you kindly take these flowers to him for me?

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: Uh, Rover, it's been a long time.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: Even when he’s lost touch with reality, he still clings on to these memories and the thought of sending them flowers ... They must have shared a special bond.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: Truth be told, sometimes when I look at him, I always feel like I see my future self.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: Sorry, I was caught in my emotions. You can have the flowers.
Have you seen Gongming's flowers, please?

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: That old man's flowers? Here they are. He left them here this morning.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: Bless him. That old man looks troubled to me. He’s always trying to bring flower bouquets to the graves every other day.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: It might have worked in the old days, but now Desorock Highland is so close to the front line that the people are no longer allowed to go up there.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: Do you know him? If so, you'd better advise him to go back to the city. It's dangerous to stay here all the time.
I'll talk him down.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: I can understand the old man's desire to return to the troop. Sometimes when I’m free, he’d have me listening to stories from his past.

speaker: Binh Sĩ Doanh Trại
anh_en: He called us by a different name each time, so I guess he thought of us as his comrades in arms.
You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hello there, stranger. Are you a Midnight Ranger? Could you do this old man a favor and check why General hasn't approved my return application?
I already delivered the flowers.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Delivered what? Are you here to tell me the approval has gone through?!

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: When did you come back? How's everything going?
Everything went well.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: That's wonderful. I hope Qiu can sense how much I miss him.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hello there, stranger. Nice to make your acquaintance. I can tell you're not from Jinzhou, are you?
I'll help you find them.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: I've been stationed in Jinzhou for a good while. Sometimes, I watch the passersby. Eventually, I can naturally tell who's a local and who isn't with just a glance!
Don't you remember me?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Don't tease me. In my entire life, the two things I'm most proud of are landing every shot and never forgetting a face.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: By the way, could you lend me a hand and deliver these flowers to someone? I can't leave my post right now. Just take them to The Lion from our regiment.
Did you pick the flowers?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Oh, indeed. How did you know? I've already gathered the flowers, and all you need to do is take them to her.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Even though we called her The Lion back in the days on the battlefield, and she is still as brave and carefree as a boy, I know she loves these beautiful flowers.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hm? Where are the flowers? I remember seeing them this morning!
You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hey, you're back so soon! Did you find my flowers? I need to send them to The Lion.
Yes, of course.
What's the matter? She didn't like them? That shouldn't be the case. All the flowers I picked were her favorites…
Well, I'll try something different next time. Anyway, thanks for your help!
Really? That's fantastic! Thanks for your trouble! Now I can stand guard in peace.
I've delivered them for you.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: How's it going? Did The Lion like it?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hello there, stranger. Are you a Midnight Ranger? Can you go up from here?

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Hold on... I could’ve sworn I don’t know you, but something about you feels so familiar… I just can't recall.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: No wonder Santong kept nagging me to keep a diary and I got so annoyed, saying "What the use of keeping one?"

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Whenever I shared a joke I learned with him, he laughed like he had to force it, as if he'd heard it many times before!

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: My memory has become muddy...

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: No, I can't go on like this. I need to cure my forgetfulness.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: Nonetheless... These flowers for Shiying— I might need to ask you to deliver them for me.
Actually, we've met before.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: What? Don't play tricks on me. In my entire life, the two things I'm most proud of are…
...landing every shot.
…and never forgetting a face.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: How... how do you know so many details?
I also know Qiu and The Lion are your comrades.

speaker: Công Minh
anh_en: How do you know them? Did we really meet before?
You put the flowers in front of the tombstone…

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I abstracted the subject and adopted a symbolistic approach to explicate the emotions. What do you think?
Pretty cool.
A large dark blob. Can't understand what you're trying to express…
Not bad. Seems to metaphorize the commonality of human emotions.
Never mind. I had fun painting it. Whether the audience understands it or not is not my concern.
Hey! You're already picking up the lingo! And... you sound very convincing.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I saw that the gallery is advertising a public tender again, and I'm to try my luck again with these pieces with a new style.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Anyway, thanks for your help! You're my muse. Wish me luck!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Take this landscape painting as a gift. Hehe, keep it well. Who knows, maybe one day it'll be worth a few grand.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Yes, the neo-classical theory influenced this painting.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Is this artwork a source of empowerment for its audience?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What? Oh... Hahaha, indeed.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Will you attend the opening ceremony of the art festival next week?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Of course, I will go. After all, they have invited me three times.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 4
anh_en: Why do you insist on street portraits?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well, it's my way to pay back to the loyal support of my fans...

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Without {Male=him;Female=her}, I wouldn't have achieved what I have today!
What's going on here…

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Rover, I owe all of this to you.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Remember the last time I joined the tender with my painting with a new style?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: That piece was quickly secured by a foreign art collector with a handsome offer!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: My works are the new buzz on the overseas market. I'm booked full until next year.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: So, I'm settling down with this new creative style. You see? They all come here for my work!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Finally, I can hold my head high. I no longer need to paint for a living, let alone beg people to buy my work. If I ever sell my art again on the street, it'll be nothing but a hobby to keep me entertained.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I really appreciate your advice. Let me paint one for you again!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Rover! Long time no see!
There are so many people here.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Relax. These are my friends and fans. All of them are art enthusiasts.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Everyone! This is the person I've mentioned multiple times, my muse, the one who has influenced my creation the most, Rover!
Dianran completes the work in a few strokes.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Oh, by the way, take this.
What's this?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Actually, my new exhibition is opening next week at a very modest venue. And by modest I mean three thousand square yards.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: We'll be showcasing over ninety pieces of my art. On the opening night, we'll hold a seminar and a banquet. I'll send you the invitation later. Do come!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Don't you think I'm even faster than before? Haha.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Rover! It's great you're here!
What's up?
Want me to pretend to be your customer again?
Hahaha! I appreciate your sense of humor. It does remind me of the days when you posed as my model.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: You know, with so many visitors here, I hate turning any of them down.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: These are completed commissioned works for my international clients. Can you help me deliver them to Huaipu Mining Firm?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I'm good friends with the boss there. I used to buy mineral pigments from them. They've agreed to help me get these paintings to the collectors.
Alright.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Thank you.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: What can I help you with today?
I'm here to drop off paintings for Dianran.

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: Oh? Already completed all of them? Haha, he's quite motivated, isn't he?

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: He's been talking about how he's out of the woods now. Still... who's to say if he's yet in another swamp?
What do you mean?

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: Haha, nothing serious. I'm just worried about him. I know what he's capable of, and all this success came quite suddenly...

speaker: Speaker_783_Title
anh_en: I'll take the paintings. No need to worry. I'll ensure they reach their collectors safely.
Dianran finished the painting while thinking.
Dianran quickly completes the painting with a few whimsical strokes.
Having you here might draw in some new customers. Thanks a bunch!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Hey! Wait! I rarely get a customer. How about this— I'll pay you to pretend to be a customer and let me paint you a portrait?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: What do you say? It's a little trick to attract more business. Don't worry. It won't take much of your time.
Fine.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Thanks a lot! Please have a seat here.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Ugh… again, painted for nothing. Oh, hey! Would you like a portrait, {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I'm a professionally trained painter. If the portrait turns out not to bear your resemblance, I won't charge you a thing.
Sure, let's do it.
No thanks.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Awesome! You seem to know the drill, right? Please take a seat here.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Please try to keep your head still. Yeah, just like that.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Fantastic! You're a very cooperative model.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: What's your take on my painting?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: It's okay! I'll keep refining my painting skills!
Except for everything about it... all good.
I'll say nothing…

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Can... Can I take that as a compliment? Honestly, you're the first to praise my artwork.
I knew someone would appreciate my efforts.
I see... Looks like I still have a lot to learn...

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Just a moment, please. I received a new message.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Rent again? Feels like I won't make it this month. Maybe it's time to look for a new place...

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Anyway, thanks for your help, even though I didn't attract any new customers...

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: My dear model, how do you like your portrait?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Stay, please! My life saver! My only hope! Please help me! No one else is willing to support me except for you! I'm begging you!
Fine, I'll help you.
Thank you! Your support means the world to me!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Thanks a bunch! I knew you wouldn't let me down!
Ugh... Just call me Rover.
Sure.
Can I refuse?
Alright, you're the boss. Rover, please take a seat.
Perfect! Have a seat, please.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: ...Can you refuse a humble artist's request?
Yes. Bye.
Fine, go on.
Dianran quickly completes the painting.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: How'd I do this time?
Looks like your plan worked. I'm leaving.
You've gotten faster at painting.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Well... I've hired quite a few people to shill for me lately, so I'm getting faster with my painting. Practice makes perfect, hehe!
I see.
You've been with other shills!
Uh-oh, don't be mad! You're always the most professional and patient of all my shills!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Thanks to these models, my business is thriving, but many customers still feel my paintings don't quite capture them, so I haven't made much money.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Anyway, I won't give up practicing! Thanks for your help! Oh, wait! Someone over there seems interested in my painting!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Alright! I'm going to approach that potential customer. See you!

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Sigh…
Landscapes.
Not much difference.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Really? Do you have any other opinions?
Try changing your style.
Try changing your career.
My style… that makes sense. Why didn't I think of that before?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: My career... I haven't thought about that at all.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I wouldn't even think about it. I still love painting. Even if no one appreciates my pieces and no one pays for them, I still don't want to give up what I truly love and enjoy.
Maybe changing my style is a good choice.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Wait, an idea suddenly came to me. Quick, take a seat. Let me put it into practice.
Why the long face?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Because my business is slow. People keep saying my paintings can't keep up with the trend.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I can't make a living just by painting… At the end of the day, all that talk about art and spiritual gratification won't pay the bills.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I thought after graduation I could make money from painting to repay my parents for the money they'd spent to put me in art school. It seemed like I was daydreaming.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: I've been thinking whether I should switch careers recently. Maybe I'm just not good at portrait painting?

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Look, yesterday I went out of Jinzhou to sketch landscapes.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Do you think I should continue to paint portraits or switch to painting landscapes?
Portraits.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: That's it! Deconstruct the reality. Use the diversity of human minds as the lead. Leverage the collective memory and emotional resonance of humanity to create a surrealistic rendition of reality.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Well, I don't understand a word of what's coming out of my mouth. I visited the exhibitions of other renowned artists. People there all talked like this.

speaker: Điểm Nhiễm
anh_en: Maybe that's what I've been missing. Don't laugh. When I say these things, I immediately feel like I'm part of the contemporary art world.
Hello, I received your message earlier.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: No, not like that.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Don't be fooled by his modest disposition. He's actually my informant from the streets.
Your informant?

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: I've been working with him for years. Smart, gutsy, sharp-eyed, good with words, and reads situations well. I always thought he'd make a good Patroller.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: But all he's ever wanted was to make people laugh. He dreams of being a Xiangsheng Master and claims it's a tradition to perform Xiangsheng at teahouses, so he won't leave there.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: You know, a teahouse is a place where people of all sorts gather. Lots of chatter and gossip. For I've helped him once a few years back, now he's doing this for me to return the favor.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: He's my eyes and ears, telling me all the street rumors, which has been a big help in solving cases.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: I'm currently on a case, and I need his info. However, every time I visited the teahouse, he signaled me to leave.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: So I think something might have happened or someone's got their eyes on him. For his safety, I can't approach him directly.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: I saw you shooting the breeze with him a few times before, so I figured maybe you could get close without blowing his cover?

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: So, you're the famous Rover, huh?
I see. I'll go talk to him for you.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Thank you. Just be careful, for both Yihu and yourself, not to blow your covers.
Got it.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: I'm contacting you on behalf of the Patrol Station. Sorry for the abrupt request.
How may I help you?

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Have you crossed paths with someone named Yihu lately?

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: He's the guy standing outside the teahouse, trying to reel in customers. Tall, thin, loves doing <ano=stand-up show>Guankou</ano>.
Yes, I know him. What happened?
Did he get into something?

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Well...

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Here you are.
Shall we practice them now?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Oh no, not necessary. They aren't worth the effort.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: When I come up with a new joke, I'll let you know.
It's my turn to share something fresh with you.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Oh? What's it?
There are wolves in the mountains.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: And that's what you call "fresh"?
For those who haven't seen wolves, it certainly is.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Haha, you're indeed interesting.
Glad you found it interesting.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: By the way, do you remember all the stories I told you before?
That's all I know.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Hmm…
Yihu assured me the information was accurate.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: I see.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Thank you. The information you provided is very helpful for solving the case.
Are all these coded messages?

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Kind of. Yihu used plain language, easy to decipher.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: He's not exactly a professional undercover, so I have to be really careful.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Thank you for your help, Rover. I'll pick up the pace of the investigation and keep you updated if there are any new leads.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Sorry, but I have to ask for another favor from you.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: If you could conduct a secret investigation, they won't catch wind of it.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Without solid proof, we're hands-tied on direct intervention.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Yihu's stayed undercover, thanks to you.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: He's a crucial informant for me, and I want to keep him safe.
Understood. I'll go check it for you.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Here's the detailed address.

speaker: Lang Sinh
anh_en: Thank you.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: People come and go, take a break, and rest your feet!

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: That's right. It's popular in my hometown, and I've been interested in crosstalk and shouting-to-sell since I was a child.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: I learned all this on my own, but I only have the courage to perform it here. It's my dream to be able to perform on the stage one day...

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: I know I still need to practice before realizing my dream, so I keep chatting with guests every day. It's a kind of practice for me. Well, hope they don't find me annoying.
That's nice.
Practice makes perfect.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Haha, did you reply to me that way on purpose? As if you were acting as a stooge.
Cause it's fun.
I've heard about it.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Don't you think our conversation is like an improvised Xiangsheng? I must say, we did it quite well.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Please, have a seat here. It seems we've formed a connection, so I'll treat you to some sunflower seeds. It's on me.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Soothe your throat with some Pu-er tea, or cool down with Laojun tea. Tea delights abound, and our menu's renowned.
Sorry, I'm busy today. I'll come back another time.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: No problem. When you have time, please come again.
Sure. Thank you!

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Hahaha, that was some good crosstalk! I've got a bunch of jokes ready to go. When you have time, I'd love to share them with you.
Can't wait to hear.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Have some of our refreshing, iced sour plum juice. A treat for all ages you won't want to miss!
Hello.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Hello there, fancy some tea? Step inside and take a seat.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Welcome to our tea house, where honesty is our policy. A sip for a coin, a treat for a bit more, and a tasting spree if you're ready to splurge!
Quite an interesting way to attract customers.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Oh, you flatter me. If our customers are pleased, they'll better appreciate our tea.
Was that a Guankou bit?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Hi there, what a coincidence! Nice to see you again.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Well, for someone as knowledgeable as you, it may not be something fresh. But a mouse stealing oil to share with a cat, that's not something you see every day, right?
No.
Tell me more.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Indeed.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: After we were closed yesterday, I cleaned up until late. When I was locking the door, I caught a glimpse of a gray rat dashing around in the shadows.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: I immediately followed it and saw the mouse hopping onto the shoulders of a little cat, sneaking into the shop through the window.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Then, the rat dipped the tip of its tail in the oil and fed it to the cat. No wonder the cat was willing to help.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: After the mouse left, I went to the cat and asked, "Why didn't you just catch the mouse and eat it?"

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: The cat glanced at me and said, "Fool. If there were no mouse stealing oil, why would they keep me? It's better to have a bit of oil every day for the long run."

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Isn't it amusing? A cat working for a mouse.
Indeed.
Really?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: If you don't believe it, why don't you take a look at the windowsill? There might be traces of oil left.
What a coincidence.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Are you busy today?
Not really.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: In that case, how about I tell you something fresh?
Go on.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Have you heard about rats stealing oil?
And that's what you call "fresh"?
You carefully check the windowsill and indeed find some traces that seems to be lamp oil.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Did you see the traces?
Yes, there are indeed traces that look like lamp oil on the windowsill.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Wow, really? Well, I just made it up on the spot. Anyway, just take it as a joke.
A not-so-funny joke.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: ... Yeah, you're right. I told it to my customers before, and they barely laughed. I still have a long way to go.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Next time, I'll share with you a more amusing one.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Hi, you're here. Are you here to see me?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Well, I appreciate it. Let's serve the tea to the table over there.
I want to know how the last joke turned out.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Oh, you reminded me.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: There's a follow-up to that joke!
Tell me.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Sorry, I can't right now. I have customers waiting for their tea.
Let me help. That'll be faster.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Thank you, but that's not good...
It's okay.

speaker: Khách Quán Trà
anh_en: Hey, newcomer, huh?
I'm just helping out.

speaker: Khách Quán Trà
anh_en: Leave the tea here. Thank you.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Thank you for your help. Okay, let me continue.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: At midnight, I saw these two cats happily sneaking out together.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Wondering why?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: The old cat shared with me that, being old and knowing the boss wouldn't keep him much longer, he had decided to sacrifice himself and let his son take over his place.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Working as a family, these two cats cleverly manipulated the boss, enjoying a feast.
What about that mouse?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Probably eaten? When there's meat to feast on, who would care about that mouse? Plus, it's a good chance to display the son's skills to the boss.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: As the saying goes, "If you let the mice guard a warehouse, there'll be nothing left," and "If you let the cats guard a house, it'll fall apart."

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: So, the story goes, the boss couldn't stand the ongoing oil theft.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Looking at his fat cat lazily grooming itself, the boss went mad and kicked the cat out in frustration.
So the cat's plan backfired, didn't it?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: You're right.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: So I thought the cat must be flustered.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Soon after, the boss brought another cat back, all majestic. I thought, finally, the oil would no longer be stolen.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Guess what happened?
What happened?
You didn't finish the story last time, did you?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Little did he know, the young cat was secretly feeding the old one with the meat.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: As time went by, those two cats got brazen. Not satisfied with just filling their bellies, they even started selling the stolen meat to stray cats.
Cats selling meat?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Yeah. What do you know? The world's full of peculiar things.
Tell me about it.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: I ran into them the other day.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: I overheard some strange muttering like, "Clouds cover the moon, people hide in shadows, and cats meow three times?"

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Didn't catch him all though. The young cat, unlike his father, was on high alert. When I approached, he hissed at me, so I didn't dare to get any closer.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: And that's why I couldn't find an end to the story.
Indeed... There's no punchline and the delivery was bland.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: No, there's much more to tell.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Well, you certainly don't sugarcoat your words, huh? If you've got the time, maybe share this story with others. Who knows, someone might find it amusing.

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: It's getting more and more intriguing.
Did you come up with this yourself?

speaker: Nhất Hồ
anh_en: Yeah. I pulled an all-nighter to write this bit. Hear it out.
